About

I’m a Computer Science & Artificial Intelligence student at IE University. I’m Jordanian, grew up for most of my life in Dubai, and I’m now based in Madrid.

I’m very interested in full-stack AI engineering: AI workflows and orchestration. I love working fast and efficiently, especially on problems that demand complex system design.
